description: Slice W6 of design/web-parity-plan.md. Looking back: Did that help (R5), What I did (PROG1), weekly look-back with fixed lines (C5), What the app remembers with per-line delete (M4). Never shaming, no streak resets, no comparisons. Saved only via js/storage.js. Independent of later slices; depends on earlier ones only for existing code.
steps: Write design/looking-back-w6.md (parent pre-approved the plan, 'go do it all'; list student-visible wording as awaiting parent okay) and run the AGENTS.md design review checklist
Put pure logic in js/logic/ with node tests incl. awkward cases; screen code in js/screens/ or existing screen files; save data only via js/storage.js
Add Playwright spec tests/browser/<slice>.spec.js: main path and awkward path (distracted, empty, refresh mid-step, damaged storage)
Add steps to tests/manual-checks.md; update PROGRESS.md and the slice table status in design/web-parity-plan.md
Self-review the diff against the AGENTS.md Stage 2 checklist, then run lint, logic tests and full browser suite via temp Chrome config (delete config after)
Commit only own files by name: git -c user.email=hagan@cih.com commit -m 'feat(web): ...'. If it cannot be finished, revert the slice and record why in PROGRESS.md
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint clean, npm run test:logic passes, browser suite passes except known flaky ai-choice.spec.js:44
Design note exists; slice committed as one commit; PROGRESS.md and plan table updated
No AGENTS.md rule 1-11 broken; nothing in ios/ changed; no AI needed
